name: Aryabhata
reason: author_or_scholar: tied almost exclusively to the 5th-century mathematician; essentially never given to boys today.

name: Bankim
reason: Good, real given name (esp. Bengal); IAST should match the name as written (no final -a).

fix.name: Bankim
fix.meaning_en: Gracefully curved, bent; an epithet of Krishna (as in Bankim Bihari).

name: Bhartrihari
reason: author_or_scholar: name of the poet-philosopher only; essentially never given as a personal name today.

name: Bhavabhuti
reason: author_or_scholar: known only as the Sanskrit dramatist's name; essentially never given today.

name: Chanakya
reason: Used as a given name; meaning should state what the name means, not only who bore it.

fix.name: Chanakya
fix.meaning_en: Descendant of Chanaka; name of the strategist-minister of Chandragupta Maurya.

name: Chandragupta
reason: Historical name families do use; meaning, script and IAST correct.

name: Kalidas
reason: Real, auspicious name; IAST should match the name as written.

fix.name: Kalidas
fix.meaning_en: Servant of Goddess Kali; name of the great Sanskrit poet.

name: Kanakadasa
reason: other: a religious name tied to the single Kannada saint-poet, essentially not given today; 'Golden servant' is also a loose rendering.

name: Krishnadevaraya
reason: overlong_compound: tied to the Vijayanagara emperor and awkward as a given name; essentially never given.

name: Madanmohan
reason: Real name of Krishna, commonly given; IAST should match the name as written.

fix.name: Madanmohan
fix.meaning_en: One who enchants even Kamadeva; a name of Krishna.

name: Mohandas
reason: Real, auspicious given name; IAST should match the name as written.

name: Namdev
reason: Real given name (esp. Maharashtra); IAST should match the name as written.

fix.name: Namdev
fix.meaning_en: God of the divine name; also the Marathi saint-poet.

name: Panini
reason: author_or_scholar: name of the grammarian only; not given to boys today (occasionally used for girls).

name: Patanjali
reason: author_or_scholar: tied to the sage of the Yoga Sutras (and now a brand); essentially never given; 'pata + anjali' split is also uncertain.

name: Prithviraj
reason: Common given name; IAST should match the name as written.

name: Pulakeshi
reason: obscure_figure: tied to the single Chalukya king and essentially never given; IAST pulakeśin also did not match the name as written.

name: Rajguru
reason: title_or_honorific: 'royal preceptor' is a title and a Marathi surname (Shivaram Rajguru), not a given name.

name: Ramprasad
reason: Common, auspicious name; IAST should match the name as written.

name: Sambhaji
reason: Real given name in Maharashtra; standard Devanagari is संभाजी (sambhājī), matching the spelling Sambhaji.

fix.name: Sambhaji
fix.meaning_en: Named after Shambhu (Shiva); the second Maratha ruler.

name: Samudragupta
reason: other: tied to the single Gupta emperor and essentially never given today, unlike Chandragupta.

name: Shivaji
reason: Widely given historical name; meaning (after goddess Shivai), script and IAST correct.

name: Sukhdev
reason: Common given name; IAST should match the name as written.

fix.name: Sukhdev
fix.meaning_en: God of happiness; giver of joy.

name: Sushruta
reason: Given today in the form Sushrut (esp. Maharashtra); Sushruta as written is tied to the ancient surgeon.

name: Tilak
reason: Common given name; IAST should match the name as written.

fix.name: Tilak
fix.meaning_en: Sacred mark on the forehead; ornament, the best of its kind.

name: Tyagaraja
reason: Name of Shiva at Tiruvarur, given in South India (Tyagaraja/Thyagarajan); meaning, script and IAST correct.

name: Vivekananda
reason: Given to boys (also as Vivekanand); meaning, script and IAST correct.
